name: arv-portfolio
description: Scroll-driven 3D photography portfolio — React + Three.js client, Node/Express server

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.cms: concurrently -n client,server,cms -c magenta,cyan,yellow "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server" "decap-server"
